name: Kisaragi Kyouko
source:
"Ah, it's really Maa-kun! You've become such a man, I was thinking twice if I should call you out or not."

The protagonist's aunt. She looks after her two daughters as a full time housewife. A kind woman who is cheerful and motherly, though a bit unhappy with her husband who's always at work, but her love for her daughters kept her from voicing out her complaints. 

She boasts a plump yet alluring and gorgeous body. Her youthful appearance is also overflowing with sensuality, which makes it unthinkable that she already gave birth to two daughters. Has an I-cup breasts, which has an overwhelming volume. Has wide, childbearing hips which attract the gaze of the men around her. However, she is worried about her drooping breasts and belly flabs. 

While her relationship with her husband has gone cold, she's on good terms with her daughters. Haven't had sex with her husband for a long time, and not knowing what to do with her ripe and alluring body, she's stressed everyday, but she tries not to show it through her behavior to keep her daughters from worrying.
